messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy v2.44.1 completed to canaries (us-east, eu-west). Post-deploy verification window: 12m. deploy_id=4a7c2.

jen: starting fast smoke: `/scripts/smoke-run --routes=rerank,realtime-embed --samples=40`

jen: smoke output: realtime-embed (eu-west) p95=1.2s (expected ~150ms), 5x 503s in last 3m. rerank p95=110ms, no errors.

victor: seeing the same in logs from embed-worker-23 in eu-west: high GC pause and repeated model load logs around deploy timestamp.

toni: can we pin eu-west to previous model-variant while we triage? prefer rollback of model binary rather than full release rollback.

jen: we can pin model-variant for the embed route. Command: `ctl model pin --route=realtime-embed --region=eu-west --variant=rv-20250211 --until=+30m`

infra-bot: model pin task queued id=mp-773.

infra-bot: model pin completed for realtime-embed eu-west -> rv-20250211.

jen: re-running smoke: realtime-embed p95=160ms, errors=0. Good.

victor: adding note to INF-4567 with heap dumps and model load traces. Looks like the new variant is triggering a memory growth pattern on that hardware profile.

toni: follow-up action: schedule a repro in staging with same hardware image and enable verbose model loader logs. I'll own a short playbook + guard to fail fast on load-time memory > 6GB.

deploy-bot: Verification window ended (12m). Status: degraded -> mitigated (model-variant pin applied). Auto-close in 1h if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
